correctness.rationale: Exact positive piecewise cubic factorization controls all functions, with precise equality points and irrational mass. Jensen reduces finite-graph optimizers to two plateaus. The unique stationarity root and constrained positive Hessian yield exact coefficient kappa, verified by symbolic algebra and independent finite-grid numerical checks. Smoothness, compactness and quadratic-irrational arithmetic prove the uniform relative asymptotic and both subsequence orders.

value.rationale: A sharp exact cubic bound for the canonical rank-one heat semigroup is accompanied by irrational occupancy rigidity, strict finite nonattainment, a computable sharp second-order coefficient, and two different infinite finite-size approximation rates determined by Diophantine approximation. This explains a substantive discretization effect in the natural family of complete-graph maximal operators.
